title: Odd One Out
tagline: Everyone matches. You don't. Stay odd for 10 minutes.
description: You are Odd, the one mismatched robot in the vale, and an endless crowd of identical Matchers wants to fix that. You only steer: your gadgets fire on their own, and every level adds something new to the pile. Survive 10 minutes, break the Template, and spend your scrap on permanent upgrades between runs.
difficultyNote: Most first runs end around three minutes. Beating the final boss takes workshop upgrades.
coverAlt: Illustration: one small odd robot with mismatched eyes glows in the middle of a closing crowd of identical grey-blue box robots.
